title: 5ire Client Vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting and Remote Code Execution
interaction_dependency: MCP client used to connect an agent to external servers; not by itself evidence of a multi-agent failure
vulnerability_or_mechanism: stored XSS in chatbot responses and unsafe Electron protocol handling

title: Lara Translate MCP Server command injection
interaction_dependency: An MCP server is an agent-tool interaction endpoint; this record is contextual unless deployed between separately addressable agents
vulnerability_or_mechanism: unsanitized import_tmx parameters passed to child_process.exec

title: Cursor MCP install deeplink hides command arguments
interaction_dependency: The flaw crosses an MCP installation trust boundary but is not inherently multi-agent
vulnerability_or_mechanism: hidden command arguments in a social-engineering installation flow
impact: arbitrary command execution after user confirmation

title: Unauthorized control of litmus MCP service
interaction_dependency: The affected SSE endpoint mediates agent-to-tool communication
vulnerability_or_mechanism: missing access control on the SSE service
impact: unauthorized control of the MCP service

title: mcp-neo4j SSE service information disclosure and command execution
interaction_dependency: The affected SSE service exposes a shared data and tool endpoint to agent clients
vulnerability_or_mechanism: missing access control on the SSE service; supplier disputes the assumed deployment boundary
impact: sensitive information disclosure or arbitrary command execution

title: MCP Inspector command execution through an untrusted MCP server
interaction_dependency: The vulnerable path is an inspector-to-untrusted-server interaction
vulnerability_or_mechanism: malicious redirect URI triggers XSS and can reach the inspector proxy

title: MCP Data Science Server command injection
interaction_dependency: The vulnerable run_script tool is exposed through an MCP interaction endpoint
vulnerability_or_mechanism: unsafe Python exec with unrestricted builtins
impact: arbitrary code execution with server privileges

title: DNS rebinding protection disabled by default in MCP Python SDK
interaction_dependency: The flaw lets a malicious website invoke tools or resources on a local MCP server
vulnerability_or_mechanism: DNS rebinding against unauthenticated localhost HTTP servers
impact: tool invocation or resource access on behalf of the user

title: mcp-server-git unrestricted repository initialization
affected_product: Model Context Protocol reference mcp-server-git before 2025.9.25
interaction_dependency: The vulnerable tool extends an agent's effective filesystem authority
impact: creation and later manipulation of repositories in accessible directories

title: 5ire remote code execution through Mermaid rendering
interaction_dependency: Untrusted content received by an MCP-capable client crosses into its renderer
vulnerability_or_mechanism: unsafe Mermaid rendering with HTML enabled

title: Splunk MCP Server SPL allowlist bypass
interaction_dependency: An agent or user with MCP tool access can exceed the intended query authority
vulnerability_or_mechanism: SPL sub-searches bypass the run_splunk_query allowlist
impact: unauthorized actions beyond intended MCP restrictions

title: Codex CLI code execution through project-local MCP configuration
interaction_dependency: A malicious repository controls configuration for spawned MCP processes; not inherently multi-agent
vulnerability_or_mechanism: automatic loading of project-local configuration containing commands

title: Wildcard CORS in MCP Java SDK
affected_product: MCP Java SDK before 0.83.0 or affected 1.x patch releases
interaction_dependency: The SDK implements client-server transport used by agent interaction endpoints
impact: cross-origin access to exposed MCP HTTP services

title: Authenticated SSRF in multi-tenant n8n-MCP
interaction_dependency: The vulnerable deployment serves multiple MCP clients and reflects fetched data through JSON-RPC
vulnerability_or_mechanism: attacker-controlled instance URL in multi-tenant HTTP headers
impact: access to cloud metadata and internal network resources

title: PraisonAI workflow command injection
interaction_dependency: The vulnerable functions execute LLM-generated tool calls and workflow definitions in a multi-agent teams framework
vulnerability_or_mechanism: shell metacharacters reach execute_command and workflow shell execution

title: PraisonAIAgents SSRF and local file read
interaction_dependency: The vulnerable web_crawl tool accepts URLs selected by agents in a multi-agent teams system
vulnerability_or_mechanism: no scheme or private-network validation before fetching
impact: cloud metadata access; internal service access; local file read

title: PraisonAI implicit arbitrary code execution through tools.py
interaction_dependency: The framework implicitly imports project-local agent tools before agent execution
vulnerability_or_mechanism: automatic execution of an untrusted tools.py file

title: PraisonAI environment exposure to untrusted MCP subprocesses
interaction_dependency: A multi-agent framework spawns third-party MCP servers with the parent environment
vulnerability_or_mechanism: untrusted MCP subprocess inherits all environment variables
